targeting_lens.brief: Round scope lens in a riveted ring with a crosshair etched on the glass. Accent: deep teal.
targeting_lens.description: Seen straight on: a round lens in a thick riveted ring, crosshair etched across the glass, one small adjustment knob on the side.

power_cell.brief: Upright battery cylinder with two chunky terminals and a charge stripe. Accent: mustard.
power_cell.description: Upright cylinder battery, two chunky terminals on top, a mustard charge stripe round its middle, a dent in the casing.

coolant_tank.brief: Dented upright tank with a frost-rimmed valve and a short hose. Accent: deep teal.
coolant_tank.description: Upright: a dented steel tank with a teal frost-rimmed valve at the top and a short hose coiled at its foot, frost crust along the seams.

lucky_comet.brief: Small comet pebble on a string, tail drawn as three ink strokes. Accent: mustard.
lucky_comet.description: A small rough pebble on a knotted string, three short ink strokes trailing from it like a comet tail. Worn smooth on one side from handling.

solar_panel.brief: Two hinged solar plates with a grid of cells, one corner cracked. Accent: deep teal.
solar_panel.description: Lying across the box: two hinged solar plates with a grid of flat teal cells, the hinge in the middle, one corner cracked.

repair_kit.brief: Battered tin box with a wrench strapped to the lid. Accent: rust red.
repair_kit.description: Lying across the box: a battered tin box with rounded corners, a wrench strapped to the lid with a leather band, a rust-red stripe painted round it.

antenna.brief: Bent whip antenna on a small base with a crackle mark at the tip. Accent: mustard.
antenna.description: A short base with a bent whip antenna rising from it, a small mustard crackle mark at the tip.

thruster.brief: Stubby rocket nozzle with scorched rim and two side fins. Accent: rust red.
thruster.description: Lying across the box, nozzle to one side: a stubby rocket nozzle with a scorched rust-red rim and two small side fins.

fuel_canister.brief: Jerrycan with a hazard flame stencil and a leaking drop. Accent: rust red.
fuel_canister.description: A small jerrycan with a flame stencil in rust red on its side, cap loose, one drop leaking from the spout.

crystal_shard.brief: Single jagged crystal spike with hard facet shadows. Accent: deep teal.
crystal_shard.description: A single jagged teal crystal spike with hard flat facets and black shadow on one side.

copper_wire.brief: Coil of wire with one loose end curling out. Accent: copper.
copper_wire.description: A loose coil of copper wire, round and neat, with one end curling out of it.

scrap_metal.brief: Bent metal plate with rivets and a torn edge. Accent: copper.
scrap_metal.description: A bent square of metal plate with three rivets and one torn edge, copper patina in the corners.

venom_sac.brief: Swollen fleshy sac with veins and one dripping drop. Accent: moss.
venom_sac.description: A swollen fleshy sac with dark veins, a drop of moss-green venom hanging from its tip.

frost_gem.brief: Six-sided gem of methane ice with a crown of frost spikes. Accent: deep teal.
frost_gem.description: A six-sided teal gem cut from the methane ice of a frozen night planet, frozen bubbles inside, frost spikes growing from its top like a crown.

lodestone.brief: Lumpy dark rock with tiny nails stuck to it. Accent: rust red.
lodestone.description: A lumpy dark rock with a few tiny nails and a bolt stuck to its sides, rust-red rust stains round them.

oxygen_tank.brief: Tall gas bottle with a gauge and a breathing mask hung on it. Accent: deep teal.
oxygen_tank.description: Upright: a tall gas bottle with a round gauge at the neck and a breathing mask hanging from it by its strap. Teal on the bottle.

biogel.brief: Squishy gel pouch with a nozzle, bubbles inside. Accent: moss.
biogel.description: A soft, squishy gel pouch with a nozzle on top, moss-green gel inside with two bubbles.

overclock_chip.brief: Square microchip with legs and a little speed arrow on top. Accent: mustard.
overclock_chip.description: A square microchip seen from above, short legs on all sides, a mustard arrow printed on top pointing forward.

star_chart.brief: Rolled-out paper map with dotted constellations, corners curling. Accent: bone.
star_chart.description: Lying across the box: a rolled-out paper map, corners curling up, a few dotted constellation lines and small star marks, no writing.

gravity_anchor.brief: Heavy ship anchor with a ring of orbit lines around the shaft. Accent: copper.
gravity_anchor.description: A small heavy ship anchor, its shaft ringed by two thin orbit lines like a tiny planet's.

geiger_counter.brief: Handheld box with a needle dial and a wand on a cable. Accent: mustard.
geiger_counter.description: A handheld box with a mustard needle dial on its face and a wand hanging on a coiled cable.

jammer_beacon.brief: Squat beacon with a zig-zag signal wave coming out of the top. Accent: rust red.
jammer_beacon.description: Upright: a squat beacon with a short antenna mast, a rust-red zig-zag signal wave coming off the top.

med_scanner.brief: Handheld scanner with a green screen showing a heartbeat line. Accent: moss.
med_scanner.description: A handheld scanner with a small screen showing a flat moss-green heartbeat line, a chunky grip below.

stardust_vial.brief: Corked glass vial with glittering dust swirling inside. Accent: mustard.
stardust_vial.description: A corked glass vial with mustard dust swirling inside, drawn as flat specks in a spiral.

holo_decoy.brief: Little projector puck casting a flickering silhouette made of dashes. Accent: deep teal.
holo_decoy.description: A little projector puck casting a silhouette of a figure made of teal dashes above it.

war_horn.brief: Curved horn of a space beast with a brass mouthpiece. Accent: copper.
war_horn.description: Lying across the box: a curved horn of a space beast, ridged, a copper mouthpiece at the narrow end and a cord tied round its middle.

star_compass.brief: Brass compass whose needle points at a star instead of north. Accent: mustard.
star_compass.description: An old brass compass seen from above, its needle pointing at a small star on the dial instead of a letter.

warp_coil.brief: Twisted coil with space bending around it in curved lines. Accent: deep teal.
warp_coil.description: Upright: a twisted coil of thick teal wire, the space around it drawn as curved bending lines.

black_box.brief: Scuffed armoured flight recorder with handle and warning stripes. Accent: rust red.
black_box.description: Lying across the box: a scuffed armoured flight recorder with a carry handle on top and rust-red warning stripes on the sides, dented corners.

dark_matter.brief: Floating black sphere with a thin bone-white rim of light. Accent: bone.
dark_matter.description: A floating black sphere with a thin bone-white rim of light, nothing else. Simple and very dark.

metronome.brief: Pyramid metronome with a swinging arm and a star at the tip. Accent: copper.
metronome.description: Upright: a pyramid-shaped wooden metronome, its arm swinging with a small star at the tip.

singularity_core.brief: Cracked containment sphere with a tiny black hole inside pulling the cracks inward. Accent: rust red.
singularity_core.description: Filling the square box: a round containment sphere in a riveted iron frame, its shell cracked; the cracks bend inward towards a tiny black hole in the middle, a rust-red ring around it. Fragments drift towards the centre.

nebula_prism.brief: Triangular prism splitting a beam into three coloured bands. Accent: mustard.
nebula_prism.description: Filling the square box: a heavy triangular glass prism on a small iron stand, a single beam entering one side and leaving as three flat bands of mustard, teal and rust red.

first_aid_patch.brief: Square plaster with a cross, one corner peeling. Accent: rust red.
first_aid_patch.description: A square plaster with a rust-red cross on it, one corner peeling up.

saline_drip.brief: IV bag on a little hook with a drip line. Accent: deep teal.
saline_drip.description: Upright: a soft IV bag hanging from a small hook, a drip line looping down, half full of teal liquid.

scrubber_unit.brief: Boxy air filter with a fan grille and a dirty filter sticking out. Accent: moss.
scrubber_unit.description: Lying across the box: a boxy air filter with a fan grille on the front and a dirty moss-coloured filter mat sticking out the side.

regen_pod.brief: Capsule pod with a round window and a sleeping blob inside. Accent: moss.
regen_pod.description: Filling the square box: a squat capsule pod with a round porthole window; inside a sleeping moss-green blob. Pipes on the side, a few dents.

healing_spring.brief: Rock basin with water bubbling up in a small fountain. Accent: deep teal.
healing_spring.description: Filling the square box: a small basin of rough rock, water bubbling up in the middle in a little fountain drawn as flat teal shapes, moss growing on the rim.

stasis_field.brief: Two emitter prongs holding a frozen bubble between them. Accent: deep teal.
stasis_field.description: Lying across the box: two emitter prongs on a short bar, holding a frozen bubble between them with a small item stuck inside.

emergency_beacon.brief: Heavy beacon with a big warning light on top and a pull handle. Accent: rust red.
emergency_beacon.description: Filling the square box: a heavy beacon on a squat base, a big rust-red warning light under a cage on top, a pull handle on a chain at the side, scratched hazard stripes.

hull_plating.brief: Curved hull panel with rivets and a painted stripe. Accent: copper.
hull_plating.description: Lying across the box: a curved slab of ship hull, edge lined with rivets, a faded copper paint stripe across it and a dent in one corner. Thick and heavy, simple shape.

space_suit.brief: Empty patched space suit, limp, helmet hanging at its side. Accent: bone.
space_suit.description: Upright in the tall box: an empty suit hanging limp as if from a hook, arms dangling, patched knees, the round helmet hanging from a strap at its side.

visor_helmet.brief: Round helmet with a big tinted visor and one scratch. Accent: mustard.
visor_helmet.description: A round helmet seen from the front, almost all visor: a big dark mustard-tinted window with one diagonal scratch, a small collar ring at the bottom.

lead_vest.brief: Heavy grey apron vest with a radiation trefoil patch. Accent: mustard.
lead_vest.description: Upright: a heavy, stiff grey apron vest with thick shoulder straps, a mustard radiation trefoil patch on the chest, edges sagging from the weight.

ablative_tiles.brief: Stack of scorched heat tiles, the top one cracked. Accent: copper.
ablative_tiles.description: A short stack of three square heat tiles seen from slightly above, edges scorched black, the top tile split by one crack.

magnetic_boots.brief: Pair of chunky boots with horseshoe magnets on the soles. Accent: rust red.
magnetic_boots.description: A pair of chunky boots side by side, soles towards the viewer, each sole with a rust-red horseshoe magnet bolted on.

rock_shell.brief: Shell made of fused asteroid rock, rough and lumpy. Accent: copper.
rock_shell.description: Lying across the box: a domed shell of fused grey asteroid rock, lumpy, with a few sharp edges where a blow could bounce back.

pilot_jacket.brief: Worn leather flight jacket with a fur collar and patches. Accent: copper.
pilot_jacket.description: Upright: a worn leather flight jacket laid out flat, sheepskin collar turned up, two square patches on the chest without text, one cuff frayed.

reactive_armor.brief: Chest plate covered in small boxy charges. Accent: rust red.
reactive_armor.description: Lying across the box: a chest plate covered in a grid of small boxy charges, two of them already blown open and blackened. Rust red on the charge caps.

deflector_dish.brief: Satellite dish turned into a shield, a ring of force in front. Accent: deep teal.
deflector_dish.description: Filling the square box: an old satellite dish turned into a shield, a grip strap on the back, a flat teal ring of force hovering just in front of the bowl. Bent rim, one missing panel.

cryo_coat.brief: Long padded coat with frost on the shoulders. Accent: deep teal.
cryo_coat.description: Upright: a long quilted coat with a high collar, frost crusted on the shoulders and hem, icicles hanging from the cuffs.

thorn_mail.brief: Vest woven from thorny vines. Accent: moss.
thorn_mail.description: Lying across the box: a vest woven from thick dark vines, black hooked thorns sticking out at every crossing, a few moss leaves between.

mirror_shield.brief: Round shield with a polished mirror face showing a reflected star. Accent: bone.
mirror_shield.description: Filling the square box: a round shield with a heavy riveted rim, the face polished flat and showing one reflected star in bone white. The reflection is drawn as a flat shape, no shine.

force_bubble.brief: Wrist emitter projecting a cracked half-dome of force. Accent: deep teal.
force_bubble.description: Lying across the box: a chunky wrist emitter on the left, from it a half-dome of force drawn as a flat teal arc with one crack running through it.

nano_weave.brief: Folded cloth made of tiny hexagons, some crawling away. Accent: deep teal.
nano_weave.description: Upright: a folded piece of cloth made of tiny teal hexagons, a few hexagons peeling off one edge and walking away on tiny legs.

phase_cloak.brief: Hooded cloak whose lower half fades into dashes. Accent: deep teal.
phase_cloak.description: Upright: a hooded cloak, the top half solid dark cloth, the lower half breaking up into rows of dashes as if it is not fully there.

bulwark_generator.brief: Big boxy generator with two shield fins and a hazard stripe. Accent: mustard.
bulwark_generator.description: Filling the wide box: a big boxy generator on skids, two angled shield fins on top like ears, mustard and black hazard stripes along the base, heavy cables and vent grilles on the sides. Worn and dented but sturdy.

shield_battery.brief: Battery with a shield emblem and a charge meter. Accent: deep teal.
shield_battery.description: Upright: a fat battery cell with a shield emblem stamped on its side and a stepped charge meter of three bars, two filled in teal.

thermal_blanket.brief: Crinkled foil blanket, folded, edges catching light as flat shapes. Accent: mustard.
thermal_blanket.description: Lying across the box: a crinkled foil blanket folded into a neat bundle, its creases drawn as hard flat mustard and bone facets, one corner flapping open.

dyson_fragment.brief: Curved slab of a giant sphere around a star, panels and struts on the inside. Accent: mustard.
dyson_fragment.description: Filling the square box: a curved slab cut from a giant sphere around a star, the inside facing the viewer with a grid of mustard panels and struts, the broken edges jagged.

wormhole_generator.brief: Ring machine with a swirling hole in the middle showing other stars. Accent: deep teal.
wormhole_generator.description: Lying across the box: a chunky ring machine on a short base, inside the ring a swirling hole showing a few distant stars in deep teal.

time_dilator.brief: Hourglass in a metal cage, the sand frozen in mid-fall. Accent: deep teal.
time_dilator.description: Upright: an hourglass in a metal cage, the sand frozen in mid-fall in the narrow neck, frost on the glass.

ancient_monolith.brief: Small black standing stone with old marks cut into it. Accent: bone.
ancient_monolith.description: A small black standing stone, worn smooth, old marks cut into it and filled with flat bone white.

quantum_dice.brief: Pair of dice, each showing several faces at once as overlapping outlines. Accent: mustard.
quantum_dice.description: Two dice side by side, each drawn with several overlapping outlines as if showing more than one face at once.

plague_vault.brief: Sealed jar with a hazard lid and green fumes leaking around the seal. Accent: moss.
plague_vault.description: Lying across the box: a sealed jar with a hazard lid clamped on, moss-green fumes leaking around the seal in curls.

titan_core.brief: Heavy reactor core in an armoured cage with spikes on the corners. Accent: rust red.
titan_core.description: Filling the square box: a heavy reactor core inside an armoured cage, spikes on the cage corners, a rust-red window on the core.

star_forge.brief: Small anvil with a tiny star burning in place of the fire. Accent: mustard.
star_forge.description: Lying across the box: a small anvil with a tiny star burning in a dish beside it instead of a fire, sparks drawn as flat mustard flecks.

galactic_cookbook.brief: Thick stained cookbook with a planet on the cover and bookmarks sticking out. Accent: rust red.
galactic_cookbook.description: A thick stained book with a planet on the cover and bookmarks sticking out, no letters.

zoo_beacon.brief: Signal lamp with paw prints on the lens. Accent: mustard.
zoo_beacon.description: A small signal lamp on a base, its lens marked with mustard paw prints.

field_pack.brief: Big canvas backpack panel with straps and patched pockets (bag, drawn as an open area). Accent: copper.
field_pack.description: The starting backpack seen flat from above, filling the whole box as one worn canvas panel. Detail only along the border: two shoulder straps, buckles, a patched corner and a rolled mat strapped across the top edge. The middle stays an even, dark, quiet surface, because items lie on top of it.

pouch.description: Seen from above: a soft lump of patched canvas cinched by a cord, its open mouth a dark hole where an item sits. Flat colour, no stitching.

belt_pocket.brief: Small two-cell belt pocket with a snap button (bag). Accent: copper.
belt_pocket.description: Seen from above, lying across both cells: a stiff little pocket of worn canvas with one snap button and a strip of belt loop along the top edge. Inside stays a dark, quiet area.

sling_bag.brief: Long narrow sling bag with a strap (bag). Accent: copper.
sling_bag.description: Seen from above, filling the long box: a narrow tube-shaped bag, the strap running along one long edge and ending in a scuffed buckle. Two patches; the middle stays plain and dark.

side_pocket.brief: L-shaped side pocket with a zip (bag). Accent: copper.
side_pocket.description: L-shaped pocket seen from above, the zip running along the inner corner; the empty corner of the box stays free. Canvas with a patched seam, quiet dark interior for items.

cargo_pocket.brief: Square cargo pocket with a flap and buckle (bag). Accent: copper.
cargo_pocket.description: Square utility pocket seen from above: a flap folded back along the top edge with one heavy buckle, a reinforced corner patch. Details stay on the rim; the inside is plain and dark.

duffel.brief: Wide duffel bag with handles and a long zip (bag). Accent: copper.
duffel.description: A wide, soft duffel seen from above, unzipped: the long zip runs around the rim, two carrying handles flop over the top edge, one end cap is patched. The open middle is an even, dark area for items.

cooler_bag.brief: Insulated cooler bag with frost on the zip and a snowflake patch (bag). Accent: deep teal.
cooler_bag.description: Square insulated bag seen from above, its padded rim quilted in diamonds, frost crust along the zip and a snowflake patch in one corner. The inside is a plain dark lining.

holster.brief: Leather holster bag with a gun-shaped stitch mark (bag). Accent: rust red.
holster.description: Square bag of thick leather seen from above, a gun-shaped stitch mark on the corner flap and two straps with buckles on the edge. The middle stays plain, darker leather.

tool_roll.brief: Rolled-out canvas tool roll with spanner slots (bag). Accent: copper.
tool_roll.description: A canvas tool roll unrolled flat: a row of empty spanner slots along one edge, a tie cord dangling from a corner. The rest is plain, worn canvas where items lie.

pet_carrier.brief: Carrier box with a barred window and a paw sticker (bag). Accent: mustard.
pet_carrier.description: A carrier box seen from above with its lid off: a barred little window on one side wall, a scratched paw sticker on the rim, a tuft of fur caught in the corner. The floor is plain and dark.

seed_satchel.brief: Satchel with seed packets peeking out and a leaf patch (bag). Accent: moss.
seed_satchel.description: Square satchel seen from above, seed packets and a dry leaf peeking out of a front pocket on one edge, a leaf patch on the flap. The middle stays plain canvas.

relic_case.brief: Old case with brass corners and a star seal (bag). Accent: mustard.
relic_case.description: An old square case seen from above, lid opened back: brass-capped corners, a worn star seal on the clasp, faded velvet inside. Detail on the corners only; the velvet is an even dark field.

padded_case.brief: Quilted padded case with a cross patch (bag). Accent: rust red.
padded_case.description: Quilted square case seen from above, puffy padding along the rim, a stitched cross patch in one corner. Soft and slightly bulging; the middle stays plain.

stasis_vault.brief: Armoured vault box with a frozen-time lock dial (bag). Accent: deep teal.
stasis_vault.description: A heavy armoured box seen from above with its lid open, filling the wide box: thick riveted walls, a big lock dial on the front wall whose hands are frozen with frost. Detail stays on the walls; the inner floor is plain and dark.

prism_laser.brief: Laser pistol with a crystal prism bolted over the muzzle. Accent: deep teal.
prism_laser.description: The same chunky body as the Laser Pistol, barrel pointing along the long side, with the jagged Crystal Shard clamped over the muzzle by two bent brackets. The shot leaves the crystal as three flat teal strokes.

twin_lasers.brief: Two laser pistols welded side by side with one shared grip. Accent: rust red.
twin_lasers.description: Filling the square box: two Laser Pistols welded side by side onto one shared grip, a crude weld seam between them, both barrels pointing the same way, rust-red emitter tips.

nail_storm.brief: Rivet gun with a drum magazine and nails spraying out. Accent: copper.
nail_storm.description: Lying across the box: the Rivet Gun with a fat drum magazine wound with copper wire, a spray of nails flying out of the nozzle as short black strokes.

flamethrower.brief: Cutter with a fuel can strapped underneath and a flame tongue at the nozzle. Accent: rust red.
flamethrower.description: Along the long box: the Plasma Cutter's body with the Fuel Canister strapped under it by belts, a hose between them, a rust-red flame tongue licking from the nozzle.

slag_mace.brief: Asteroid lump fused onto a scrap pole, hot seams drawn as flat cracks. Accent: rust red.
slag_mace.description: Upright: an Asteroid Chunk fused onto a pole of bent scrap metal, the seams between rock and metal drawn as flat rust-red cracks.

glacier_cannon.brief: Short fat cannon caked in ice, a coolant tank on its back. Accent: deep teal.
glacier_cannon.description: Filling the square box: a short fat cannon caked in ice, the Coolant Tank strapped on its back with a hose to the breech, icicles hanging from the muzzle.

fungal_mortar.brief: Stubby mortar tube with mushrooms growing out of the barrel. Accent: moss.
fungal_mortar.description: Filling the square box: a stubby mortar tube standing at an angle, a cluster of moss-capped mushrooms growing out of the barrel, spore pods in a sling on its side.

emp_cannon.brief: Cannon with a coil ring at the muzzle and zig-zag sparks. Accent: mustard.
emp_cannon.description: Filling the square box: the Ion Blaster grown into a cannon, a big coil ring at the muzzle and the Jammer Beacon bolted on top, flat mustard zig-zag sparks around the ring.

plasma_katana.brief: Slim curved energy blade with a wrapped hilt and a crystal in the guard. Accent: rust red.
plasma_katana.description: Upright through the tall box: a slim, slightly curved blade of rust-red plasma, a wrapped hilt below, the Crystal Shard set into the round guard.

winch_harpoon.brief: Harpoon gun with a big winch drum and coiled cable. Accent: copper.
winch_harpoon.description: Along the long box: the Harpoon Launcher with a big winch drum bolted underneath, copper cable wound on it and running to the barbed head.

venom_fang.brief: Fang dagger with a venom sac tied to the hilt, dripping. Accent: moss.
venom_fang.description: The Fang Dagger with the Venom Sac tied to its hilt by cord, a moss-green drop running down the fang.

cryo_baton.brief: Stun baton with a frosty tip and ice crystals on the shaft. Accent: deep teal.
cryo_baton.description: Upright: the Stun Baton with its prongs iced over, a Frost Gem fitted between them, frost crystals on the shaft.

burst_rifle.brief: Long rifle with a scope and a three-shot burst mark at the muzzle. Accent: mustard.
burst_rifle.description: Along the long box: the Needle Rifle with the Targeting Lens mounted as a scope, three short muzzle marks at the barrel's end showing a three-shot burst.

laser_turret.brief: Tiny tripod turret made from scrap, a crystal for an eye. Accent: deep teal.
laser_turret.description: Lying across the box: a tiny tripod turret built from bent scrap metal and wire, the Crystal Shard set in its head as an eye, teal.

buzz_blade.brief: Spinning saw disc with a boomerang-shaped handle. Accent: copper.
buzz_blade.description: The round saw disc sits in the upper left cell, the boomerang-shaped handle bends across the top and down the left; the lower right cell stays empty. Teeth as sharp black triangles.

acid_sprayer.brief: Spray gun with a bubbling acid flask and a frosty nozzle. Accent: moss.
acid_sprayer.description: The spray gun runs along the top row, the Acid Flask hangs below it in the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. A frosty nozzle and moss-green acid bubbling in the flask.

reinforced_bulkhead.brief: Thick door-like plate with cross bracing and big bolts. Accent: copper.
reinforced_bulkhead.description: Along the long box: a thick door-like plate with cross bracing in an X and big bolts at each corner, Hull Plating patched with scrap.

spiked_bulkhead.brief: Bulkhead plate with sharp spikes along the edge. Accent: rust red.
spiked_bulkhead.description: Filling the square box: a heavy bulkhead plate with rust-red spikes along all edges and small blown-open charges from the Reactive Armor on its face.

exo_suit.brief: Space suit with a metal frame around the limbs and a helmet with visor. Accent: mustard.
exo_suit.description: Upright through the tall box: the patched Space Suit standing stiff inside a metal frame along arms and legs, the Visor Helmet on top with its mustard visor.

aegis_projector.brief: Dish shield with a battery strapped on, projecting a flat hexagon of force. Accent: deep teal.
aegis_projector.description: Filling the square box: the Deflector Dish with the Power Cell strapped to its back, projecting a flat teal hexagon of force in front of it.

thorn_plate.brief: Metal chest plate wrapped in thorny vines. Accent: moss.
thorn_plate.description: Filling the square box: a metal chest plate from Hull Plating wrapped tightly in thorny moss-green vines, thorns poking through the rivet holes.

hazmat_suit.brief: Bulky hazard suit with a lead-lined collar and a trefoil patch. Accent: mustard.
hazmat_suit.description: Filling the square box: a bulky hazard suit laid flat, a thick lead-lined collar, a mustard trefoil patch on the chest, heavy gloves.

glacier_mail.brief: Armour of ice plates, frost gems set in the chest. Accent: deep teal.
glacier_mail.description: Filling the square box: a suit of armour made of overlapping ice plates, Frost Gems set into the chest in a row, icicles at the hem.

ghost_shroud.brief: Torn cloak drifting in dashes, an empty hood with two faint eyes. Accent: bone.
ghost_shroud.description: The hood fills the upper left cell, the cloak spreads across the top and down the left, breaking into dashes; the lower right stays empty. An empty dark hood with two faint bone-white eyes.

sniper_scope.brief: Long scope with a crystal lens and crosshair. Accent: deep teal.
sniper_scope.description: A long scope seen slightly from the side, a crystal lens at the front and a crosshair at the back. Teal on the lens.

fusion_battery.brief: Battery wrapped in copper coil with a hot core window. Accent: mustard.
fusion_battery.description: The Power Cell wound in copper coil, a small round window in the middle showing a hot mustard core.

afterburner.brief: Thruster with a fuel can strapped on, long flame out the back. Accent: rust red.
afterburner.description: Lying across the box: the Thruster with the Fuel Canister strapped on top, a long rust-red flame shooting out of the back.

nano_medkit.brief: Medkit with a gel-filled window and tiny crawling robots on the lid. Accent: moss.
nano_medkit.description: Lying across the box: the Repair Kit's tin box with a window of moss-green gel in the lid and a few tiny robots crawling out of it.

solar_array.brief: Three folding solar plates on a mast with an antenna on top. Accent: deep teal.
solar_array.description: Along the long box: three folding solar plates on a mast, the Antenna on top with a crackle mark. Teal cells.

astrolabe.brief: Brass astrolabe of nested rings with a star at the centre. Accent: mustard.
astrolabe.description: Lying across the box: a brass astrolabe of nested rings, a small mustard star at the centre, a few dotted lines on the plate.

shock_trap.brief: Spring trap with a decoy projector and crackling jaws. Accent: mustard.
shock_trap.description: Lying across the box: a spring-jaw trap with the Holo Decoy's projector puck sitting in the middle as bait, mustard sparks crackling between the jaws.

fallout_beacon.brief: Beacon with a radiation trefoil and a rock base. Accent: mustard.
fallout_beacon.description: The Geiger Counter fitted onto a base of Lodestone rock, a mustard radiation trefoil on its top.

war_banner.brief: Tattered banner on a pole with a horn hung from it. Accent: rust red.
war_banner.description: Lying across the box: a tattered rust-red banner on a short pole, the War Horn hung from the pole by a cord, the Lucky Comet tied to the tip.

crit_array.brief: Ring of small lenses around a central crosshair. Accent: deep teal.
crit_array.description: A ring of small lenses around a central crosshair lens, held together in a teal frame.

overdrive_core.brief: Chip on a thruster block with exhaust vents and speed stripes. Accent: rust red.
overdrive_core.description: Lying across the box: the Overclock Chip bolted onto a Thruster block, exhaust vents and rust-red speed stripes along its side.

life_tank.brief: Tank with a gauge and a red cross, a tube coiled around it. Accent: rust red.
life_tank.description: Filling the square box: the Oxygen Tank laid sideways with the Repair Kit strapped against it, a rust-red cross on the tank and a tube coiled round both.

inferno_canister.brief: Two fuel cans welded together, flames licking out. Accent: rust red.
inferno_canister.description: Upright: two Fuel Canisters welded together, rust-red flames licking from their caps.

toxic_gland.brief: Two venom sacs grown together, oozing. Accent: moss.
toxic_gland.description: Upright: two Venom Sacs grown together into one, veins crossing between them, moss-green ooze dripping.

blizzard_gem.brief: Two frost gems grown together into a cluster with snow swirling. Accent: deep teal.
blizzard_gem.description: Upright: two Frost Gems grown together into one cluster, a swirl of snow around them drawn as flat flecks.

prism_cluster.brief: Cluster of crystal shards growing out of one base. Accent: deep teal.
prism_cluster.description: Several teal Crystal Shards growing out of one base in a fan, hard flat facets.

reactor_heart.brief: Round reactor core with copper coils and a hot window, like a heart. Accent: rust red.
reactor_heart.description: Lying across the box: a round reactor core shaped like a heart, copper coils wrapped round it, a rust-red window in the middle and two small exhaust vents.

fire_drakeling.brief: Small dragon hatchling with ember spots, smoke from its nose. Accent: rust red.
fire_drakeling.description: Lying across the box: a small dragon hatchling curled half out of its Cosmic Egg shell, ember spots on its skin, smoke curling from its nose.

frost_hatchling.brief: Small dragon hatchling with icy scales and a frosty breath. Accent: deep teal.
frost_hatchling.description: Lying across the box: a small dragon hatchling with icy teal scales sitting in its broken Cosmic Egg shell, a puff of frost breath.

slime_pup.brief: Blob of slime shaped like a puppy, one floppy ear. Accent: moss.
slime_pup.description: A blob of moss-green slime shaped like a puppy, one floppy ear, a bit of egg shell stuck to its back.

clockwork_chick.brief: Wind-up chick with a key on its back and copper feathers. Accent: copper.
clockwork_chick.description: A wind-up chick with copper wire feathers, a key on its back, half an egg shell on its head.

hamster_wheel.brief: Hamster running in a wheel with a battery attached. Accent: mustard.
hamster_wheel.description: Lying across the box: the Space Hamster running inside a wheel, the Power Cell strapped to the frame with a cable to the axle.

lunar_moth.brief: Tiny pale moth with moon crescents on its wings, two smaller moths behind it. Accent: bone.
lunar_moth.description: A tiny pale moth with moon crescents on its wings, two even smaller moths fluttering behind it, dust falling as flat bone specks.

fortress_crab.brief: Crab carrying a piece of hull plating as its shell. Accent: copper.
fortress_crab.description: Filling the square box: the Rock Crab carrying a curved piece of Hull Plating as its shell, rivets showing, claws raised.

plague_slug.brief: Fat slug with mushrooms on its back, slime trail. Accent: moss.
plague_slug.description: Filling the square box: a fat slug with moss-capped mushrooms growing out of its back, a slime trail behind it.

welder_bot.brief: Small robot with a welding torch arm and a scrap shield. Accent: mustard.
welder_bot.description: Lying across the box: the Repair Bot with a welding torch for one arm and a scrap shield on the other, a mustard eye.

gunship_drone.brief: Hovering drone with a laser pistol under its belly. Accent: rust red.
gunship_drone.description: Filling the square box: the Sentry Drone grown bigger, the Laser Pistol mounted under its belly, rust-red emitter tip, four rotor arms.

drill_mole.brief: Mole wearing a mining pick on its snout like a drill. Accent: copper.
drill_mole.description: Filling the square box: the Asteroid Mole with the Mining Pick's head strapped to its snout like a drill, digging claws forward.

medic_drone.brief: Round drone with a red cross and a little arm holding a wrench. Accent: rust red.
medic_drone.description: Lying across the box: the Scout Drone with a rust-red cross on its top and a little arm holding a wrench.

magma_hound.brief: Hound with cracked lava skin and a fiery tail. Accent: rust red.
magma_hound.description: Filling the square box: a hound with cracked lava skin like the Magma Newt and the Comet Fox's long rust-red tail streaming behind it.

snow_lynx.brief: Lynx with frosted fur and icy ear tufts. Accent: deep teal.
snow_lynx.description: Filling the square box: the Shadow Lynx's shape covered in frosty teal fur, icicle ear tufts and two pale eyes.

hawk_eye_parrot.brief: Parrot with a targeting monocle over one eye. Accent: rust red.
hawk_eye_parrot.description: The Laser Parrot with the Targeting Lens worn as a monocle over one eye, rust-red feathers.

jelly_swarm.brief: Cluster of small floating jellyfish trailing tentacles. Accent: moss.
jelly_swarm.description: Filling the square box: a cluster of small floating jellyfish trailing tentacles, a slug-like trail of slime between them.

beetle_lantern.brief: Beetle with a crystal on its back used as a lamp. Accent: mustard.
beetle_lantern.description: The Glow Beetle with a Crystal Shard on its back used as a lamp, the lit abdomen a flat mustard shape.

dust_storm.brief: Swirl of dust bunnies and moths whirling together. Accent: bone.
dust_storm.description: Lying across the box: a swirl of Dust Bunnies and Moon Moths whirling together, drawn as a spiral of fluff and wings.

star_hatchling.brief: Hatchling bursting out of a star-speckled egg, wings of light drawn flat. Accent: mustard.
star_hatchling.description: Lying across the box: a hatchling bursting out of a star-speckled egg, wings of flat mustard light, a drop of Royal Jelly on its beak.

astronaut_ration.brief: Vacuum-sealed meal tray with cheese cube and bar. Accent: bone.
astronaut_ration.description: Lying across the box: a vacuum-sealed meal tray with compartments, a Moon Cheese cube and a Protein Bar inside.

fire_jerky.brief: Strip of jerky with a red chili tied on, smoking. Accent: rust red.
fire_jerky.description: Lying across the box: a strip of jerky with a Rocket Chili tied on by string, smoke rising in wavy lines.

garden_bowl.brief: Bowl of lettuce and algae with a drink straw. Accent: moss.
garden_bowl.description: Lying across the box: a bowl of Hydro Lettuce leaves and algae with a straw stuck in, moss green.

space_burger.brief: Stacked burger with dumpling bun, cheese and lettuce, a flag pick on top. Accent: mustard.
space_burger.description: Lying across the box: a stacked burger with two Gravity Dumplings as the bun, cheese and lettuce in between, a small flag pick on top.

chili_noodles.brief: Steaming noodle box with chilies sticking out and chopsticks. Accent: rust red.
chili_noodles.description: Lying across the box: a steaming noodle box with Rocket Chilies sticking out and chopsticks.

honey_cake.brief: Round cake dripping honey, crystal candy on top. Accent: mustard.
honey_cake.description: Lying across the box: a round cake dripping Asteroid Honey down its side, Crystal Candy pieces on top.

sundae.brief: Tall sundae glass with a frozen comet scoop and a cherry star. Accent: deep teal.
sundae.description: Lying across the box: a tall sundae glass on its side, a frozen comet scoop and a star-shaped cherry on top.

turbo_cola.brief: Fizzing cola can with a lightning bolt label and a gel pack taped on. Accent: rust red.
turbo_cola.description: Upright: a cola can with a lightning bolt label without text, an Energy Gel pack taped to its side, fizz rising.

spore_stew.brief: Pot of stew with mushrooms floating and spores puffing up. Accent: moss.
spore_stew.description: Lying across the box: a small pot of stew with mushrooms and dumplings floating in it, spores puffing up as flat moss dots.

candied_fruit.brief: Star-shaped fruit coated in crystal sugar on a stick. Accent: mustard.
candied_fruit.description: Lying across the box: a Star Fruit coated in crystal sugar on a stick, the sugar drawn as flat facets.

void_beam.brief: Long emitter gun firing a black beam with a bone-white edge. Accent: bone.
void_beam.description: Upright through the tall box: the Prism Laser grown long into an emitter gun, the crystal replaced by a black Dark Matter sphere; the beam is black with a bone-white edge.

gatling_laser.brief: Rotating barrel laser with a battery pack. Accent: rust red.
gatling_laser.description: Filling the square box: a rotating cluster of laser barrels from the Twin Lasers, the Fusion Battery strapped at the back with a cable to the barrels.

dragon_engine.brief: Flamethrower shaped like a dragon head with thruster fins. Accent: rust red.
dragon_engine.description: Along the long box: the Flamethrower's barrel shaped like a dragon head at the front, the Thruster's fins and nozzle at the back, flame from the mouth.

neutron_hammer.brief: Huge two-handed hammer with a heavy dense core set in the head. Accent: mustard.
neutron_hammer.description: The heavy head fills the upper four cells, the haft drops down the lower left; the lower right stays empty. The Slag Mace's rock head bound into an iron frame, a dense mustard core set in the middle.

absolute_zero.brief: Ice-crusted cannon with a snowflake on the barrel, frozen mist around it. Accent: deep teal.
absolute_zero.description: Filling the tall box: the Glacier Cannon standing upright, encrusted in thick ice, a snowflake on the barrel and frozen mist curling round its base. Comet Sorbet frost trails across the ice.

bloom_artillery.brief: Big gun barrel overgrown with blossoms and spore pods. Accent: moss.
bloom_artillery.description: Filling the wide box: a big gun barrel lying sideways, overgrown with blossoms and spore pods, the Plague Slug curled round the breech, mushrooms on the muzzle.

storm_coil.brief: Cannon wrapped in a tesla coil with lightning arcs. Accent: mustard.
storm_coil.description: Filling the square box: the EMP Cannon wrapped in a tall tesla coil, flat mustard lightning arcs jumping round it, the Overclock Chip on the side.

citadel_plating.brief: Wall of overlapping armour plates with a small dish on top. Accent: copper.
citadel_plating.description: Filling the wide box: a wall of overlapping armour plates from the Reinforced Bulkhead, a small Deflector Dish on top like a watchtower.

life_support_suit.brief: Space suit with a backpack of tubes and a heartbeat display on the chest. Accent: moss.
life_support_suit.description: The suit fills the upper four cells, its backpack of tubes hangs into the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. The Exo Suit with a moss-green heartbeat display on the chest and medkit pouches on the belt.

star_piercer.brief: Very long rail rifle with a scope and a star-shaped muzzle flash. Accent: mustard.
star_piercer.description: Along the long box: a very long rail rifle like the Railgun with the Sniper Scope on top, a star-shaped muzzle flash in flat mustard.

captains_dinner.brief: Tray with a covered dish, ration and jerky, a napkin folded like a star. Accent: bone.
captains_dinner.description: Filling the square box: a tray with a covered dish, the Astronaut Ration and Fire Jerky beside it, a napkin folded like a star.

solar_drake.brief: Winged drake with sun-flare frills around its neck. Accent: mustard.
solar_drake.description: Filling the square box: a winged drake with sun-flare frills around its neck, a pot of Magma Curry steaming at its feet, mustard frills.

titan_crab.brief: Giant crab with a mirror shield as its shell and spikes. Accent: copper.
titan_crab.description: Filling the wide box: a giant crab with the Mirror Shield as its shell, heavy spikes on the rim, two huge claws raised, copper-coloured plated legs.

glacier_drake.brief: Long drake with ice-plated back and frosty breath. Accent: deep teal.
glacier_drake.description: Filling the square box: a long drake with ice-plated back, Ice Ferret fur at its neck, a puff of frosty breath.

command_drone.brief: Big drone with antennas, a gun and a medic cross on top. Accent: rust red.
command_drone.description: Filling the wide box: a big drone with antennas, the Gunship Drone's gun underneath and the Medic Drone's cross on its top, four rotor arms.

grand_buffet.brief: Long table piled with cake, noodles and bowls. Accent: mustard.
grand_buffet.description: Filling the wide box: a long table piled with Honey Cake, Chili Noodles and bowls, a mustard tablecloth hanging over the edge.

aegis_fortress.brief: Small fortress made of shield plates with a dish tower. Accent: deep teal.
aegis_fortress.description: Filling the tall box: a small fortress made of shield plates stacked upwards, the Aegis Projector's dish on a tower at the top, the Force Bubble's half-dome over its gate.

plague_hydra.brief: Three-headed snake with dripping venom fangs. Accent: moss.
plague_hydra.description: The three heads fill the upper four cells, the body coils down into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. A three-headed snake with dripping Venom Fangs, small jellyfish clinging to its neck.

inferno_blade.brief: Long burning sword with fuel canisters on the guard. Accent: rust red.
inferno_blade.description: Upright through the tall box: the Plasma Katana burning with rust-red flames, the Inferno Canister fixed to the guard as a fuel tank.

worldbreaker.brief: Gigantic hammer with a small black planet as the head. Accent: rust red.
worldbreaker.description: Filling the tall box: a gigantic hammer, the Neutron Hammer's haft at the bottom, its head replaced by a small black planet with a bone-white rim, cracks in the rock around it.

death_blossom.brief: Flower made of many gun barrels arranged as petals. Accent: rust red.
death_blossom.description: Filling the wide box: a flower made of many gun barrels arranged as petals, the Void Beam's black barrel at the centre, the Gatling Laser's barrels around it.

phoenix.brief: Bird of fire rising, wings spread, ash feathers falling. Accent: rust red.
phoenix.description: Filling the square box: a bird of fire rising, wings spread wide, flames drawn as flat rust-red tongues with black edges, ash feathers falling below. A Star Fruit clutched in its talons.

entropy_engine.brief: Machine half frozen and half rotting, a cannon barrel in the middle. Accent: moss.
entropy_engine.description: Filling the box, the lower right cell empty: a machine half frozen and half rotting. Left side Absolute Zero's ice and snowflake, right side Bloom Artillery's blossoms and spores, a cannon barrel through the middle.

dyson_bastion.brief: Fortress wall built from curved panels around a small star. Accent: mustard.
dyson_bastion.description: Filling the whole box: a fortress wall built from curved Dyson-like panels around a small mustard star at its centre, the Citadel Plating's plates as outer walls, the Aegis Fortress's dish tower on top.

leviathan.brief: Huge sea-beast of space, armoured head with tentacles coiling out. Accent: deep teal.
leviathan.description: Filling the whole box: a huge sea-beast of space, its head armoured with the Titan Crab's mirror shell, the Void Kraken's tentacles coiling out below it. One great teal eye.

med_bay.brief: Small medical cabinet with an IV bag and filter fan. Accent: rust red.
med_bay.description: The cabinet fills the top row, the IV bag hangs into the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. A small medical cabinet with a filter fan from the Scrubber Unit and the Saline Drip's bag.

shield_capacitor.brief: Shield battery with an extra cell clipped on and a spark. Accent: deep teal.
shield_capacitor.description: Upright: the Shield Battery with an extra Power Cell clipped on, a small flat teal spark jumping between them.

trauma_kit.brief: Big red bag with a cross, an oxygen bottle strapped on. Accent: rust red.
trauma_kit.description: Upright: a big rust-red bag with a cross patch, the Oxygen Tank strapped to its side, a First Aid Patch on the flap.

panacea.brief: Small bottle with moss growing in the cork, thick green liquid. Accent: moss.
panacea.description: Lying across the box: a small bottle with Medi Moss growing out of its cork, thick moss-green liquid inside, the Antitoxin pen lying beside it.

caretaker_bot.brief: Small robot with a towel arm and a filter mask face, kind look. Accent: bone.
caretaker_bot.description: Lying across the box: a small robot with a towel over one arm and a filter mask face, a kind round eye, the Repair Bot's wrench in the other hand.

survival_suit.brief: Space suit wrapped in a foil blanket. Accent: mustard.
survival_suit.description: Filling the square box: the Space Suit wrapped in a crinkled foil Thermal Blanket like a cape, the helmet sticking out at the top.

power_meal.brief: Lunch box with a protein bar and vitamin pills. Accent: mustard.
power_meal.description: Lying across the box: a lunch box with a Protein Bar and a blister of vitamin pills inside, lid open.

sanctuary.brief: Small domed shrine with a fountain and a red cross on the door. Accent: deep teal.
sanctuary.description: Filling the tall box: a small domed shrine of stone with a painted cross on its door, the Healing Spring's fountain bubbling in front of it in flat teal shapes.

protein_bar.brief: Wrapped bar with a bite taken out of it. Accent: copper.
protein_bar.description: A wrapped bar, the foil peeled back at one end with a bite taken out of it, copper-coloured wrapper without text.

moon_cheese.brief: Cheese wheel shaped like a cratered mini moon, a crumb orbiting it. Accent: mustard.
moon_cheese.description: A small cheese wheel shaped like a cratered mini moon, one wedge cut out showing the pale inside, a single crumb orbiting it like a tiny moon. Mustard rind.

ice_cream.brief: Freeze-dried ice cream brick in a torn foil wrapper. Accent: rust red.
ice_cream.description: Upright: a freeze-dried ice cream brick in a torn foil wrapper, three coloured layers visible, the top layer rust red.

algae_shake.brief: Tall cup of green shake with a bent straw. Accent: moss.
algae_shake.description: Upright: a tall cup with a moss-green shake and a bent straw, a few bubbles at the top.

hydro_lettuce.brief: Lettuce head in a little hydroponic cup with roots hanging out. Accent: moss.
hydro_lettuce.description: A lettuce head in a small hydroponic cup, roots hanging down below the cup.

mushroom_cluster.brief: Bunch of three mushrooms with spotted caps. Accent: moss.
mushroom_cluster.description: Three small mushrooms of different heights growing from one clump, spotted moss caps.

gravity_dumplings.brief: Two dumplings that float above their bowl. Accent: bone.
gravity_dumplings.description: Two plump dumplings hovering just above their small bowl, a short shadow gap between them and the bowl.

energy_gel.brief: Squeeze pouch with a lightning bolt on it. Accent: mustard.
energy_gel.description: A squeeze pouch with a mustard lightning bolt on it and a twist cap.

cosmic_egg.brief: Speckled egg with a tiny star pattern, slightly cracked. Accent: bone.
cosmic_egg.description: A speckled egg with a small star pattern on its shell and a hairline crack near the top.

rocket_chili.brief: Lava-planet chili with basalt skin and rocket fins. Accent: rust red.
rocket_chili.description: A chili from a lava planet: cracked black basalt skin with rust-red heat in the cracks as flat colour, stubby rocket fins at the stem.

space_noodles.brief: Noodle cup with noodles floating up out of it. Accent: mustard.
space_noodles.description: Lying across the box: a noodle cup with noodles floating up out of it in loose curls, chopsticks stuck in.

star_fruit.brief: Star-shaped fruit, cut in half. Accent: mustard.
star_fruit.description: A star-shaped fruit cut in half, the cut face showing a star of seeds. Mustard.

nova_cola.brief: Cola bottle with a starburst label and fizz. Accent: rust red.
nova_cola.description: Upright: a glass cola bottle with a starburst label without text and fizz bubbles rising from the neck.

crystal_candy.brief: Hard candy shaped like a crystal on a stick. Accent: deep teal.
crystal_candy.description: A hard candy shaped like a teal crystal on a stick.

comet_sorbet.brief: Scoop of comet ice in a dented ration cup, frozen dust tail. Accent: deep teal.
comet_sorbet.description: A scoop of dirty comet ice in a dented ration cup, a long tail of frozen dust streaming off it as if still flying, a spoon on a tether cord.

asteroid_honey.brief: Honey jar shaped like a lumpy asteroid, honey dripping. Accent: mustard.
asteroid_honey.description: Lying across the box: a lumpy honey jar shaped like an asteroid, honey dripping over the edge, a wooden dipper stuck in.

magma_curry.brief: Bowl of curry bubbling like lava. Accent: rust red.
magma_curry.description: Lying across the box: a bowl of curry bubbling like lava, black crust cracking over rust-red sauce, a spoon in it.

royal_jelly.brief: Small jar of thick jelly with a crown on the lid. Accent: mustard.
royal_jelly.description: A small jar of thick jelly with a little crown pressed into the lid.

captains_banquet.brief: Huge platter with a roast and fruits under a dome lid. Accent: copper.
captains_banquet.description: Filling the wide box: a huge oval platter with a roast under a half-lifted dome lid, fruit and bread piled around it, a copper rim. Rich but still drawn in flat shapes with heavy shadows.

antitoxin.brief: Small syringe pen with a green cap. Accent: moss.
antitoxin.description: A small syringe pen with a moss-green cap and a little window showing the dose.

medi_moss.brief: Clump of soft moss in a petri dish. Accent: moss.
medi_moss.description: A clump of soft moss in a small petri dish, the lid tilted to one side.

vitamin_pack.brief: Blister pack of round pills. Accent: mustard.
vitamin_pack.description: A blister pack of round pills, two already pushed out.

bone_broth.brief: Steaming mug of broth with a tiny comet drawn on it. Accent: copper.
bone_broth.description: A steaming mug of broth with a small comet painted on the side, steam drawn as wavy ink lines.

life_orchid.brief: Orchid flower in a pot, petals shaped like hearts. Accent: rust red.
life_orchid.description: Upright: an orchid in a small pot, its petals shaped like hearts in rust red.

seed_pod.brief: Hard seed pod with a split seam spitting seeds, a paper specimen tag tied to its stem. Accent: moss.
seed_pod.description: A hard seed pod split along one seam, spitting small seeds, a paper specimen tag from Venn's lab tied to its stem.

watering_drone.brief: Small dented drone with a watering-can spout and a faded stencil patch, a vine wound round one leg. Accent: deep teal.
watering_drone.description: Venn's botanist's old drone, still following the suit: round, dented, spout forward, one vine wound round its single leg. The stencil is a faded patch, no letters.

compost_bin.brief: Station lab bin, lid forced open by tendrils, peels and leaves spilling out. Accent: moss.
compost_bin.description: A station lab bin, its lid forced open by tendrils, peels and leaves spilling out over the rim.

thornvine.brief: Long vine with hooked thorns, a torn strip of suit fabric caught on it. Accent: moss.
thornvine.description: Along the long box: a long vine with hooked black thorns, a torn strip of Venn's suit fabric caught on one thorn.

pollen_cloud.brief: Puffy cloud of pale pollen grains drifting from a cracked seed bulb. Accent: mustard.
pollen_cloud.description: A cracked pale seed bulb like those in Venn's visor, a puffy cloud of mustard pollen grains drifting from it.

grow_lamp.brief: Bent lab grow lamp on an arm, tendrils curling up towards it. Accent: mustard.
grow_lamp.description: A bent lab grow lamp on a jointed arm, rust-red tendrils curling up towards it.

venus_mantrap.brief: Snapping offshoot with toothy jaws on a tendril stem, no eyes. Accent: rust red.
venus_mantrap.description: Lying across the box: a snapping offshoot of Venn, toothy jaws on a tendril stem, no eyes, rust-red inside the jaws.

moon_melon.brief: Big pale melon with crater spots, rust-red tendrils creeping over it. Accent: moss.
moon_melon.description: Filling the square box: a big pale melon with crater spots, rust-red tendrils from Venn creeping over it and a specimen tag tied to the stalk.

healing_moss.brief: Pad of moss in a cracked petri dish with a lab label. Accent: moss.
healing_moss.description: A pad of soft moss in a cracked petri dish, a lab label without text.

root_network.brief: Tangle of roots spreading wide through broken station pipes. Accent: copper.
root_network.description: Along the long box: a tangle of roots spreading through broken station pipes, pipe joints cracked open by the roots.

carnivorous_orchid.brief: Orchid with a toothed mouth among its petals, no eyes. Accent: rust red.
carnivorous_orchid.description: Lying across the box: an orchid with a toothed mouth among its petals, no eyes, rust-red throat.

spore_mine.brief: Round spore pod with spikes, about to burst. Accent: moss.
spore_mine.description: Lying across the box: a round spore pod with spikes, about to burst, made from a Seed Pod with mushroom caps growing out of it.

giant_mantrap.brief: Huge offshoot with several snapping jaws on coiled tendrils. Accent: rust red.
giant_mantrap.description: The jaws fill the top row, the coiled tendrils drop into the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. A huge offshoot with several snapping jaws, no eyes.

harvest_crate.brief: Station supply crate overflowing with odd vegetables, roots growing through the slats. Accent: copper.
harvest_crate.description: Filling the square box: a station supply crate overflowing with odd vegetables and a Moon Melon, roots growing through the slats.

briar_fortress.brief: Wall of thick thorny branches grown around a station door frame. Accent: moss.
briar_fortress.description: An arch of thick thorny branches: the top row is the lintel, the two lower corners are the posts, the gap between them stays empty like a doorway. The bent frame of a station door shows through the branches; a torn strip of suit fabric and pale seed bulbs hang in the thorns. Thorns as hard black hooks.

hydra_bloom.brief: Plant with three snapping flower heads on long tendril stems. Accent: rust red.
hydra_bloom.description: The three heads fill the upper four cells, the stems drop into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. A plant with three snapping flower heads on long tendril stems, one of them an orchid.

irrigation_swarm.brief: Three small watering drones like Venn's, spraying a leaf, each with a faded stencil patch. Accent: deep teal.
irrigation_swarm.description: Lying across the box: three small watering drones like the botanist's old one, spraying a single leaf, each with a faded stencil patch.

world_seed.brief: Large seed split open, bark and thorns bursting out of the crack. Accent: moss.
world_seed.description: Filling the square box: a large seed split open, rough bark and long thorns bursting out of the crack, a tiny planet of moss caught between them.

queen_spore.brief: Large seed bulb crowned by a ring of smaller bulbs, pale and swollen. Accent: moss.
queen_spore.description: A large pale seed bulb like those in Venn's visor, crowned by a ring of smaller swollen bulbs.

terrarium_heart.brief: Heart-shaped lab terrarium, glass cracked by the plants pushing out. Accent: moss.
terrarium_heart.description: Lying across the box: a heart-shaped lab terrarium, its glass cracked by moss and tendrils pushing out.

bramble_seed.brief: Small spiky seed in a specimen vial. Accent: moss.
bramble_seed.description: A small spiky seed in a specimen vial from Venn's lab, the cork pushed half out.

sap_tap.brief: Lab tap driven into a piece of bark, sap dripping into a beaker. Accent: mustard.
sap_tap.description: A lab tap driven into a piece of bark, mustard sap dripping into a small beaker.

snap_sprout.brief: Tiny sprout with a biting mouth, poking out of a seed tray. Accent: moss.
snap_sprout.description: A tiny sprout with a biting mouth poking out of a seed tray, no eyes.

bark_shield.brief: Shield of thick bark with a suit patch grown into the middle. Accent: copper.
bark_shield.description: Lying across the box: a shield of thick bark, a patch from Venn's suit grown into the middle.

nectar_flask.brief: Lab flask with golden nectar, a leaf pushed in as the cork. Accent: mustard.
nectar_flask.description: Upright: a lab flask with golden nectar, a leaf pushed into the neck as a cork.

blight_bomb.brief: Rotten swollen fruit used as a bomb, fumes rising. Accent: moss.
blight_bomb.description: A rotten swollen fruit used as a bomb, a fuse made of a dried stem, moss-green fumes rising.

strangler_fig.brief: Fig vines strangling a station pipe until it bends. Accent: moss.
strangler_fig.description: Along the long box: fig vines strangling a station pipe until it bends, roots coiling round the pipe joints.

ironbark_golem.brief: Small hulking golem of bark and stones, a seed bulb where a head should be. Accent: copper.
ironbark_golem.description: Filling the square box: a small hulking golem of bark and stones, a pale seed bulb where a head should be, no face.

sun_blossom.brief: Big flower whose centre is a cluster of pale seed bulbs, petals like a sun. Accent: mustard.
sun_blossom.description: Filling the square box: a big flower whose centre is a cluster of pale seed bulbs like those in Venn's visor, petals arranged like a sun in mustard.

thorn_pod.brief: Seed pod covered in hooked thorns. Accent: moss.
thorn_pod.description: Lying across the box: the Seed Pod covered in hooked thorns from the Bramble Seed.

mantrap_pack.brief: Two little snapping offshoots sharing one cracked lab pot. Accent: moss.
mantrap_pack.description: Lying across the box: two little snapping offshoots sharing one cracked lab pot.

living_armor.brief: Suit chest plate overgrown with bark and vines, seams split. Accent: moss.
living_armor.description: The plate fills the top row, the overgrown sleeve drops into the lower left; the lower right cells stay empty. A suit chest plate overgrown with bark and vines, seams split.

jungle_tyrant.brief: Monstrous plant beast of jaws and vine arms, a torn suit glove stuck on one vine. Accent: moss.
jungle_tyrant.description: Filling the wide box: a monstrous plant beast of jaws and vine arms, the Strangler Fig's roots as legs, a torn suit glove stuck on one vine.

ambrosia.brief: Lab bowl of golden nectar with moss leaves floating in it. Accent: mustard.
ambrosia.description: Filling the square box: a lab bowl of golden nectar with moss leaves floating in it, a few drops running down the side.

plague_blossom.brief: Sickly flower puffing toxic pollen, kindly offered on a long stem. Accent: moss.
plague_blossom.description: Lying across the box: a sickly flower on a long stem, held out like a gift, puffing moss-green toxic pollen.

space_pup.brief: Shaggy herd pup with big paws, a soft horn stub and a comet-like tail. Accent: mustard.
space_pup.description: A young pup of Quill's herd: shaggy mustard fur, oversized paws, a soft stubby horn on its forehead like a young behemoth, and a bushy tail that streams behind it like a small comet.

treat_pouch.brief: Woven pouch of dried berries and roots the herd gathers. Accent: copper.
treat_pouch.description: A small pouch woven from grass by the herd, open at the top, dried berries and roots spilling out, a tuft of shed fur on the knot.

pet_bed.brief: Round woven nest padded with shed fur. Accent: rust red.
pet_bed.description: Lying across the box: a round low nest woven from twigs and padded with shed fur, a dent in the middle where an animal slept. Rust-red woven band.

pack_lizard.brief: Long low lizard carrying woven bundles on its back. Accent: moss.
pack_lizard.description: Filling the square box: a big, long, low lizard of the herd walking sideways, woven bundles tied on its back, a calm heavy-lidded eye.

kibble_sack.brief: Woven sack of dried seeds and roots, a fur tuft on the knot. Accent: copper.
kibble_sack.description: Upright: a woven sack of dried seeds and roots, tied with cord, a tuft of fur on the knot, a few seeds spilt at the bottom.

burrow_rat.brief: Rat with an asteroid-rock armoured back and two teal crystal front teeth. Accent: copper.
burrow_rat.description: A rat peeking out of a round hole in the ground, its back armoured with small grey asteroid-rock plates, strong digging claws and two big teal crystal front teeth.

hatchery.brief: Salvaged egg incubator, its lid replaced by a woven nest of eggs under shed fur. Accent: mustard.
hatchery.description: Filling the square box: a dented salvaged incubator box with a small heater coil and a dial, its broken lid replaced by a woven nest full of round eggs, half covered by shed fur. Mustard on the eggs' speckles, cords tying the nest to the metal.

star_falcon.brief: Falcon with star-speckled wing tips, diving. Accent: mustard.
star_falcon.description: Upright: a falcon diving head-first, wings folded back, wing tips speckled with small mustard stars.

calling_shell.brief: Spiral sea shell on a cord, its mouth worn smooth from humming into it. Accent: copper.
calling_shell.description: A spiral sea shell on a braided cord, its mouth worn smooth from humming into it. Quill calls the herd with it; no whistle.

tusked_behemoth.brief: Huge shaggy beast with four tusks, low and heavy, a small woven nest between its horns. Accent: copper.
tusked_behemoth.description: Quill's mount, the same beast as in the hero design. A huge, low, shaggy body filling the box sideways, head to one side with four curved tusks under a heavy brow and tiny eyes. Between its horns an empty woven nest (Quill herself is not in the picture). Matted fur in heavy clumps, two small animals clinging to its flank.

hive_queen.brief: Furry insect queen with a crown-shaped head, tiny workers crawling round her. Accent: mustard.
hive_queen.description: Filling the square box: a furry insect queen seen from above, her head shaped like a crown, folded wings and a striped body, a ring of tiny workers crawling round her.

star_hound.brief: Shaggy hound with star-speckled fur. Accent: deep teal.
star_hound.description: Lying across the box: the Space Pup grown into a shaggy hound with the Burrow Rat's long front teeth, star-speckled teal fur.

sun_eagle.brief: Eagle with a sun-ray crest of stiff feathers. Accent: mustard.
sun_eagle.description: The spread wings fill the top row, the body and talons drop into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. The Star Falcon grown into an eagle with a crest of stiff feathers like sun rays.

cozy_den.brief: Den dug into a hill, lined with shed fur and a woven nest inside. Accent: rust red.
cozy_den.description: Filling the square box: a den dug into a small hill, lined with shed fur, the Pet Bed's nest visible inside and the Kibble Sack leaning at the entrance.

shell_dragon.brief: Heavy dragon with a turtle-like shell, moss on top. Accent: copper.
shell_dragon.description: Filling the square box: the Pack Lizard grown into a big heavy dragon with the Rock Crab's lumpy shell on its back, moss on top, thick legs planted wide.

celestial_chimera.brief: Beast with a lion head, eagle wings and a star tail, wild-maned. Accent: mustard.
celestial_chimera.description: The body fills the upper four cells, the star tail drops into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. A beast with the Star Hound's wild mane and the Sun Eagle's wings, its tail ending in a small star.

rat_pack.brief: Three rats sitting on top of each other. Accent: copper.
rat_pack.description: The rats fill the top row and the lower left cell, the lower right stays empty. Three Burrow Rats sitting on top of each other, the top one holding a seed from the Kibble Sack.

elder_tusk.brief: Old cracked tusk tip on a braided cord, scratched with herd marks. Accent: rust red.
elder_tusk.description: The cracked tip of an old herd tusk on a braided cord, scratched with herd marks. A rust-red bead on the cord.

herd_heart.brief: Smooth stone heart wrapped in braided fur, scratched with animal outlines. Accent: mustard.
herd_heart.description: Lying across the box: a smooth stone heart wrapped in braided fur, scratched with simple animal outlines.

ancient_egg.brief: Large stone egg with old carvings, tiny creatures hatching from cracks. Accent: bone.
ancient_egg.description: Filling the square box: a large stone egg with old carvings spiralling round it, many small cracks with tiny creatures pushing out of them.

feeding_bowl.brief: Hollow half of a big shell, filled with berries and roots. Accent: rust red.
feeding_bowl.description: The hollow half of a big shell used as a bowl, filled with berries and roots. Rust-red berries.

guard_goose.brief: Angry space goose, wings spread, hissing. Accent: bone.
guard_goose.description: An angry space goose, wings spread wide, neck stretched forward, beak open in a hiss.

grooming_comb.brief: Wide bone comb with tufts of fur caught in its teeth. Accent: rust red.
grooming_comb.description: A wide bone comb with tufts of shed fur caught in its teeth, a rust-red cord on its handle.

war_saddle.brief: Woven saddle pad padded with fur, tusk-tip studs on the edge. Accent: copper.
war_saddle.description: A woven saddle pad padded with fur, tusk tips as studs along the edge.

moon_bear.brief: Big shaggy bear with a crescent mark on its chest. Accent: bone.
moon_bear.description: Filling the square box: a big shaggy bear sitting up, a bone-white crescent mark on its chest, small eyes and a heavy brow.

glow_swarm.brief: Swarm of fireflies, their lit tails drawn as flat mustard dots. Accent: mustard.
glow_swarm.description: Lying across the box: a loose swarm of fireflies, their lit tails drawn as flat mustard dots, bodies as tiny ink shapes.

thunder_ram.brief: Ram with curled horns, ink zig-zag sparks between them. Accent: mustard.
thunder_ram.description: Filling the square box: a ram lowering its head, curled horns, flat mustard zig-zag sparks crackling between them, shaggy coat.

nursery.brief: Old warming cradle machine, padded by the herd, young animals asleep in a heap. Accent: mustard.
nursery.description: Filling the square box: an old rocking warming cradle of riveted metal with a small heater vent and a crank, padded with woven grass and shed fur by the herd, young animals asleep in a heap inside, one pup's ears sticking out.

sky_serpent.brief: Long flying serpent with fins and a shaggy mane. Accent: deep teal.
sky_serpent.description: Along the long box: a long flying serpent with fins along its back and a shaggy mane, its body in one smooth wave, teal scales.

guard_hound.brief: Shaggy hound standing guard, teeth bared. Accent: rust red.
guard_hound.description: Lying across the box: the Space Pup grown into a hound standing guard, teeth bared, the Guard Goose's feathers tucked in its collar of fur.

armored_bear.brief: Bear wearing a woven saddle and plates of bark and bone. Accent: copper.
armored_bear.description: Filling the square box: the Moon Bear wearing the War Saddle, plates of bark and bone strapped round its chest, crescent mark still showing.

juggernaut.brief: Massive horned beast charging, small animals clinging to its fur. Accent: rust red.
juggernaut.description: Filling the wide box: the Tusked Behemoth charging with the Thunder Ram's curled horns, small animals clinging to its fur, dust kicked up as flat strokes.

banquet_trough.brief: Long hollow log filled with berries, roots and seeds. Accent: copper.
banquet_trough.description: Lying across the box: a long hollow log filled with berries, roots and seeds, the Feeding Bowl's shell at one end.

swarm_cloud.brief: Cloud of furry insects with a queen in the middle. Accent: mustard.
swarm_cloud.description: Filling the square box: a cloud of furry insects swirling, the Hive Queen in the middle with her crown-shaped head, lit tails as mustard dots.

pack_bond.brief: Two braided fur cords knotted together with a bead. Accent: rust red.
pack_bond.description: Two braided fur cords knotted together, the Calling Shell on one end and a rust-red bead on the other.

welding_arm.brief: Rook's tool leg with a welding torch at the end, scorched and patched. Accent: mustard.
welding_arm.description: One of Rook's six tool legs as a spare part: a jointed metal limb standing upright in the box, torch at the top end with a short flat flame. Mismatched patch plates, scorch marks round the tip, a loose cable along the joint.

spare_parts.brief: Little hoard of gears, bolts and a spring, kept "for later". Accent: copper.
spare_parts.description: A little hoard of gears, bolts and a spring, kept for later, a bit of wire tying them together.

circuit_board.brief: Salvaged circuit board with chips and traces, one corner burnt. Accent: moss.
circuit_board.description: A salvaged circuit board with chips and traces in moss green, one corner burnt black.

conveyor_belt.brief: Short conveyor belt pieced together from wreck parts, a bolt riding on it. Accent: copper.
conveyor_belt.description: Lying across the box: a short conveyor belt pieced together from wreck parts, one bolt riding on it, rollers of different sizes.

toolbox.brief: Dented metal toolbox, one hinge replaced with wire. Accent: rust red.
toolbox.description: Lying across the box: a dented metal toolbox, rust-red paint chipped, one hinge replaced with a twist of wire.

magnet_crane.brief: Crane hook with a big horseshoe magnet, scrap hanging off it. Accent: rust red.
magnet_crane.description: Lying across the box: a short crane arm with a big rust-red horseshoe magnet on its hook, a scrap plate and two bolts hanging off it.

junk_cannon.brief: Cannon built from pipes and a bucket, held with clamps. Accent: copper.
junk_cannon.description: Lying across the box: a cannon built from pipes and an old bucket, held with clamps, a fuse of copper wire.

recycler.brief: Boxy scrap machine with a hopper and a little mustard lamp like an eye. Accent: moss.
recycler.description: Lying across the box: a boxy scrap machine with a hopper on top, a small mustard lamp on the front like Rook's lantern eye, a chute below.

tesla_coil.brief: Coil tower made of salvaged wire with a ball on top and ink zig-zag sparks. Accent: mustard.
tesla_coil.description: Upright: a tower of salvaged wire coils with a metal ball on top, flat mustard zig-zag sparks around the ball.

assembly_core.brief: Cube core with small tool arms folding around it. Accent: mustard.
assembly_core.description: A cube core with small tool arms folding round it, like Rook's legs, a mustard light on top.

plasma_welder.brief: Welding gun with a plasma tip and a scrap guard. Accent: deep teal.
plasma_welder.description: Upright: Rook's Welding Arm rebuilt into a welding gun, a teal plasma tip and a guard of scrap metal at the grip.

scrap_howitzer.brief: Big gun of welded scrap with a funnel barrel, bolted to a piece of satellite housing. Accent: copper.
scrap_howitzer.description: Filling the square box: a big gun of welded scrap with a funnel barrel, bolted to a curved piece of satellite housing like Rook's shell, copper wire around the breech.

logic_core.brief: Salvaged chip with a battery taped on and a lantern-eye sticker. Accent: deep teal.
logic_core.description: A salvaged chip with the Power Cell taped on, a round sticker shaped like Rook's lantern eye. Teal traces.

salvage_rig.brief: Magnet crane on a recycler base, both welded together. Accent: rust red.
salvage_rig.description: Filling the square box: the Magnet Crane welded on top of the Recycler, a scrap plate hanging from the magnet, the mustard lamp-eye still on the front.

arc_forge.brief: Welding gun wrapped in a coil, sparks drawn as ink zig-zags. Accent: mustard.
arc_forge.description: Filling the square box: the Plasma Welder wrapped in the Tesla Coil's wire, a short flame at its tip, flat mustard sparks as ink zig-zags.

factory_line.brief: Conveyor belt with tool arms and a toolbox at the end. Accent: copper.
factory_line.description: Lying across the box: the Conveyor Belt with two of Rook's spare tool arms bolted above it and the Toolbox at the end.

master_blueprint.brief: Rolled blueprint of a satellite shell with a pencil tucked in. Accent: deep teal.
master_blueprint.description: A rolled blueprint half open, showing the outline of a satellite shell like Rook's, a pencil tucked into the roll. Teal paper.

perpetual_engine.brief: Small engine with a flywheel, patched from three different wrecks. Accent: copper.
perpetual_engine.description: Lying across the box: a small engine with a big flywheel, patched together from three different wrecks, each part a different metal.

nanite_swarm.brief: Cloud of tiny robots, each a minute copy of Rook, forming a cube. Accent: deep teal.
nanite_swarm.description: Lying across the box: a cloud of tiny robots, each a minute copy of Rook with a satellite shell, forming a rough cube.

capacitor_bank.brief: Row of three fat salvaged capacitors on a scrap board. Accent: mustard.
capacitor_bank.description: Lying across the box: three fat salvaged capacitors in a row on a scrap board, mustard bands round each.

bolt_thrower.brief: Small crossbow built from a tool leg, firing bolts. Accent: copper.
bolt_thrower.description: Upright: a small crossbow built from one of Rook's tool legs, a bolt loaded, the string made of copper wire.

grav_clamp.brief: Heavy clamp with a gravity ring symbol, taken from a docking arm. Accent: deep teal.
grav_clamp.description: A heavy clamp taken from a docking arm, a teal gravity ring symbol on its jaw.

shield_emitter.brief: Small dish emitter cut from a satellite antenna. Accent: deep teal.
shield_emitter.description: A small dish emitter cut from a satellite antenna like the ones on Rook's shell, a teal ring of force in front.

turbo_fan.brief: Cooling fan from a wreck with bent blades. Accent: copper.
turbo_fan.description: A cooling fan from a wreck with bent copper blades in a square frame.

scrap_golem.brief: Walking robot of scrap with a single mustard lantern eye. Accent: copper.
scrap_golem.description: Lying across the box: a walking robot of scrap, a single mustard lantern eye like Rook's, mismatched legs.

rail_driver.brief: Long rail gun made from two salvaged copper rails. Accent: copper.
rail_driver.description: Along the long box: a long rail gun made from two salvaged copper rails, bound together with wire and clamps.

bastion_frame.brief: Heavy armour frame of hull plates, like a bigger shell. Accent: copper.
bastion_frame.description: Filling the square box: a heavy armour frame of hull plates shaped like a bigger satellite shell for Rook, a hatch in the middle.

quantum_forge.brief: Anvil inside an atom-shaped cage of bent rails. Accent: mustard.
quantum_forge.description: Filling the square box: an anvil inside an atom-shaped cage of bent rails, mustard sparks where the rails cross.

rivet_cannon.brief: Big rivet gun on a three-legged stand. Accent: copper.
rivet_cannon.description: Upright through the tall box: a big rivet gun on a three-legged stand, the legs taken from the Bolt Thrower and the Welding Arm.

dynamo.brief: Generator with a spinning drum and loose wires. Accent: mustard.
dynamo.description: Lying across the box: a generator with a spinning drum, the Turbo Fan on one side, loose wires to the Capacitor Bank.

bulwark_array.brief: Row of dish emitters on a scrap frame. Accent: deep teal.
bulwark_array.description: Filling the square box: a row of dish emitters on the Bastion Frame, each a Shield Emitter, teal rings of force overlapping.

storm_driver.brief: Rail gun with ink storm lines and zig-zag sparks around the barrel. Accent: mustard.
storm_driver.description: The rail gun runs along the top row, a battery box hangs in the lower left; the lower right cells stay empty. The Rail Driver with the Dynamo strapped under it, flat mustard sparks around the barrel.

junk_titan.brief: Huge robot made of scrap with a satellite housing on its back. Accent: copper.
junk_titan.description: Filling the square box: a huge robot made of scrap, a curved satellite housing on its back like Rook's shell, Spare Parts sticking out of every joint.

gravity_well.brief: Ring machine pulling small bolts into its middle. Accent: deep teal.
gravity_well.description: Lying across the box: a ring machine on the Magnet Crane's arm, small bolts being pulled into its middle, teal rings.

sun_shard.brief: Broken piece of a dying sun, cracked flat mustard and rust, wavy heat lines. Accent: mustard.
sun_shard.description: A broken piece of a dying sun, cracked flat mustard and rust, wavy heat lines rising, no glow.

prayer_bell.brief: Small iron bell on a wrist cord, like the one Ysel wears. Accent: mustard.
prayer_bell.description: A small iron bell on a wrist cord, the same as the one Ysel wears, a mustard clapper.
