eclipse_veil.brief: Heavy dark veil cloth with a rust-red band and a black disc stitched on. Accent: bone.
eclipse_veil.description: Lying across the box: a heavy dark veil cloth of Ysel's order with a rust-red band, a black disc stitched on, folded once.

sundial.brief: Iron sundial whose shadow points at a cracked star. Accent: copper.
sundial.description: A small iron sundial whose shadow points at a cracked star cut into the plate.

flare_catcher.brief: Bent iron ring on a pole catching a curling flare. Accent: mustard.
flare_catcher.description: Lying across the box: a bent iron ring on a pole catching a curling flare, the flare drawn as a flat mustard ribbon.

ember_censer.brief: Hanging iron censer with embers and wavy heat lines. Accent: rust red.
ember_censer.description: Upright: a hanging iron censer on chains with embers inside, wavy heat lines rising from its lid.

corona_staff.brief: Staff topped by an open iron cage holding a cracked sun fragment. Accent: mustard.
corona_staff.description: Upright staff of Ysel's order: a plain dark iron shaft with a rust-red band, crowned by an open cage of bent iron rings like her own reliquary. Inside floats a cracked sun piece, flat mustard with black cracks and wavy heat lines.

comet_rosary.brief: Rosary of small stones with one comet-shaped bead. Accent: bone.
comet_rosary.description: Along the long box: a rosary of small round stones like the ones on Ysel's belt, one bead shaped like a comet.

dawn_chime.brief: Iron chime of hanging tubes cut with sun rays. Accent: mustard.
dawn_chime.description: An iron chime of hanging tubes, each tube cut with small sun rays.

red_giant_heart.brief: Swollen red star in a cage of bent iron rings, cracks widening. Accent: rust red.
red_giant_heart.description: Filling the square box: a swollen rust-red star in a cage of bent iron rings like a reliquary, its cracks widening, heat drawn as wavy lines.

collapse_engine.brief: Iron machine with a cracked star collapsing into its core. Accent: rust red.
collapse_engine.description: Lying across the box: an iron machine with a cracked star collapsing into its core, pieces falling inward.

sunblade.brief: Short iron sword with a sun shard set in the hilt. Accent: mustard.
sunblade.description: Upright: a short iron sword of the order, the Sun Shard set in the hilt, the Crystal Shard ground into its edge.

chime_of_hours.brief: Iron bell with a sundial on top. Accent: mustard.
chime_of_hours.description: Lying across the box: the Prayer Bell with the Sundial fixed on top as its crown.

helios_rod.brief: Long iron rod topped by a small burning sun in rings. Accent: mustard.
helios_rod.description: Upright through the tall box: the Corona Staff grown longer, the Ember Censer hanging from its top cage, a small burning sun inside.

umbral_mantle.brief: Heavy dark robe of the order with rust-red bands, its shadow longer than it should be. Accent: bone.
umbral_mantle.description: Filling the square box: the heavy dark robe of Ysel's order with rust-red bands, laid flat, its shadow longer than it should be.

dying_star_scepter.brief: Sceptre with a red dying star trapped in a cage of bent iron rings. Accent: rust red.
dying_star_scepter.description: The cage fills the upper four cells, the shaft drops into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. A sceptre with the Red Giant Heart trapped in a cage of bent iron rings.

solstice_engine.brief: Iron engine with two half-suns on its sides. Accent: mustard.
solstice_engine.description: Filling the square box: an iron engine with two half-suns on its sides, the Dawn Chime hanging from it, the Flare Catcher's ring on top.

nova_crown.brief: Crown of bent iron rings around a dark, frozen star. Accent: deep teal.
nova_crown.description: Lying across the box: a crown of bent iron rings around a dark star gone cold, frost cracks on its surface, pieces held still in the rings.

eternal_dawn.brief: Small sun rising out of an iron ring, never quite up. Accent: mustard.
eternal_dawn.description: A small sun rising out of an iron ring, never quite up, half hidden behind the ring.

stellar_lens.brief: Large lens in an iron frame focusing a star into a beam. Accent: deep teal.
stellar_lens.description: A large lens in an iron frame focusing a star into a single teal beam.

votive_candle.brief: Candle in a small stone cup, a star pressed into the wax. Accent: mustard.
votive_candle.description: A candle in a small stone cup, a star pressed into the wax, a flat mustard flame.

hymn_scroll.brief: Open scroll with hymns written as star notes. Accent: bone.
hymn_scroll.description: Lying across the box: an open scroll with hymns written as star notes, no letters.

solar_dagger.brief: Iron dagger with a sun etched on the blade. Accent: mustard.
solar_dagger.description: A small iron dagger with a mustard sun etched on the blade.

mirror_of_dusk.brief: Iron hand mirror showing a setting red sun. Accent: rust red.
mirror_of_dusk.description: Upright: an iron hand mirror showing a setting rust-red sun.

star_psalter.brief: Thick hymn book with an iron star clasp. Accent: mustard.
star_psalter.description: Lying across the box: a thick hymn book of the order with an iron star clasp.

pyre_lantern.brief: Iron lantern with a small fire inside, heat lines above. Accent: rust red.
pyre_lantern.description: An iron lantern with a small fire inside, wavy heat lines rising from the top.

eclipse_orb.brief: Stone orb with a black disc crossing a sun. Accent: bone.
eclipse_orb.description: Lying across the box: a stone orb with a black disc crossing a sun, held in a small iron stand.

white_dwarf.brief: Small, very dense white star held in a heavy iron ring. Accent: bone.
white_dwarf.description: Filling the square box: a small, very dense bone-white star held in a heavy iron ring, the ring bending under its weight.

supernova_seed.brief: Seed-shaped iron cage with a star about to burst inside. Accent: rust red.
supernova_seed.description: Lying across the box: a seed-shaped iron cage with a star about to burst inside, its cracks rust red.

twin_suns.brief: Two sun daggers crossed. Accent: mustard.
twin_suns.description: Upright: the Sun Shard and the Solar Dagger crossed, both with sun marks in mustard.

sacred_flame.brief: Flame in a stone bowl, wavy heat lines rising. Accent: rust red.
sacred_flame.description: A flame in a stone bowl like the Votive Candle's cup, the Pyre Lantern's iron frame around it, wavy heat lines.

litany.brief: Long scroll wrapped around an iron bell. Accent: bone.
litany.description: Along the long box: the Hymn Scroll wrapped around an iron bell, the Comet Rosary hanging from it.

total_eclipse.brief: Round iron shield painted with a total eclipse. Accent: bone.
total_eclipse.description: The shield fills the top row and the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. A round iron shield painted with a total eclipse, the Mirror of Dusk set in its centre.

event_horizon.brief: Black ring shield with stars bending around its edge. Accent: deep teal.
event_horizon.description: Filling the tall box: a black ring shield with stars bending round its edge, the White Dwarf at its centre, the Umbral Mantle hanging behind it.

canticle.brief: Open hymn book with a flare curling up from its pages. Accent: mustard.
canticle.description: Lying across the box: the Star Psalter open, a flare curling up from its pages as a flat mustard ribbon.

space_hamster.brief: Hamster from a desert planet, cheeks full of ore pebbles. Accent: mustard.
space_hamster.description: A round hamster from a thin-air desert planet, cheeks stuffed with shiny ore pebbles, frilly breathing gills on its neck, small room around it. Mustard fur.

moon_moth.brief: Moth from a planet with two moons. Accent: bone.
moon_moth.description: A pale moth from a planet with two moons, each wing marked with two dark crescents, feathery antennae, fuzzy body, wings spread wide.

vacuum_slug.brief: Slug with a suction mouth and a slime trail. Accent: moss.
vacuum_slug.description: Lying across the box: a fat slug with a round suction mouth at the front, a moss-green slime trail behind it. Dry little eye stalks.

rock_crab.brief: Squat crab from a heavy desert planet, sandstone shell, crystal claw. Accent: copper.
rock_crab.description: A squat flat crab from a heavy-gravity desert planet, its shell a slab of layered red sandstone, short thick legs, one oversized claw of rough pale crystal.

glow_beetle.brief: Tiny beetle with a lamp-like rear drawn as a flat mustard shape. Accent: mustard.
glow_beetle.description: A beetle seen from above, its rear end a round lamp drawn as a flat mustard shape, legs and feelers in ink.

asteroid_mole.brief: Mole with big digging claws and goggles. Accent: copper.
asteroid_mole.description: Upright: a stubby mole standing on its hind legs, huge digging claws in front, cracked goggles pushed up on its head.

dust_bunny.brief: Rolling ball of grey fluff from a windy desert, tiny dust devil below. Accent: bone.
dust_bunny.description: A round ball of grey fluff from a windy desert planet, rolling like a tumbleweed, two long ears, two dot eyes, a tiny dust devil spinning under it.

scout_drone.brief: Small drone with one big camera eye. Accent: deep teal.
scout_drone.description: A small round drone with one big camera eye in deep teal and two little rotor arms.

comet_fox.brief: Long-legged fox from an icy comet, tail like a comet tail. Accent: rust red.
comet_fox.description: A lean fox from a small icy comet, long thin legs for low gravity, mid-leap across the box. Its tail streams behind it as a long trail of frozen dust like a comet tail. Big ears like tiny antenna dishes.

repair_bot.brief: Small round robot with a wrench arm. Accent: mustard.
repair_bot.description: A small round robot on two stubby legs, one arm a wrench, one round mustard eye.

laser_parrot.brief: Parrot with a laser pointer in its beak. Accent: rust red.
laser_parrot.description: A parrot perched sideways with a small laser pointer in its beak, a straight rust-red line shooting out of it.

nebula_jelly.brief: Floating jellyfish with a nebula pattern in its bell. Accent: deep teal.
nebula_jelly.description: Lying across the box: a floating jellyfish, its round bell showing a flat swirl of nebula clouds, tentacles trailing behind.

sentry_drone.brief: Hovering drone with a small gun underneath. Accent: rust red.
sentry_drone.description: Upright: a hovering drone with a small rust-red gun mounted underneath, two rotor arms on top, one lens eye.

magma_newt.brief: Newt from a lava planet with basalt skin. Accent: rust red.
magma_newt.description: A newt from a lava planet lying across the box, its skin cracked like cooling black basalt with rust-red heat in the cracks as flat colour, its tail ending in a lump of volcanic glass, steam as wavy ink lines.

ice_ferret.brief: Ferret with frosty white fur and icy whiskers. Accent: deep teal.
ice_ferret.description: Lying across the box: a long, slinky ferret with frosty white fur and icicle whiskers, tail curled.

tardigrade.brief: Chubby tardigrade with eight stubby legs. Accent: bone.
tardigrade.description: A chubby, wrinkled tardigrade with eight stubby clawed legs and a round mouth, bone-coloured.

shadow_lynx.brief: Lynx made of shadow with two bone-white eyes. Accent: bone.
shadow_lynx.description: The lynx's body fills the top row, its head and front paws drop into the lower left cell; the right lower cell stays empty. A cat shape of pure black shadow with ear tufts and two bone-white eyes.

star_whale_calf.brief: Baby whale with a star-speckled back, swimming through space. Accent: deep teal.
star_whale_calf.description: Filling the wide box: a chubby baby whale swimming sideways through space, its back speckled with small stars like freckles, a big curious eye and a short spout of mist. Underbelly in pale bone with grooves, the back deep teal.

void_kraken.brief: Kraken of the void with long tentacles and one big eye. Accent: deep teal.
void_kraken.description: A dark tentacled beast filling the box: head and body across the top two rows, two thick tentacles hanging into the bottom corners, the middle bottom cell empty. One huge round eye in deep teal is the focus; suckers as plain bone-white dots, skin night-blue under heavy black shadow.

guardian_drone.brief: Drone with a round shield in front. Accent: deep teal.
guardian_drone.description: Lying across the box: a drone hovering behind a round shield plate held in front of it by two arms, deep teal on the shield.

purifier_bot.brief: Small robot with an air filter mask. Accent: moss.
purifier_bot.description: A small robot with a big moss-green air filter mask for a face, a little round body and two thin arms.

laser_pistol.brief: Chunky laser pistol with a heat sink on the barrel. Accent: rust red.
laser_pistol.description: Upright in the tall box, barrel pointing up: a blocky pistol in chipped grey plating, a ribbed heat sink along the barrel, the grip wrapped in tape. Rust red on the emitter tip.

rivet_gun.brief: Hull-repair rivet gun built from a thruster nozzle. Accent: copper.
rivet_gun.description: A stubby hull-repair gun built from a cut-down thruster nozzle. Fat rivets ride round the barrel on a wire ring like a planet ring; the muzzle is a rubber suction clamp for hull plates. Copper hose fittings.

plasma_cutter.brief: Handheld cutter with a short plasma flame. Accent: deep teal.
plasma_cutter.description: Lying across the box: a stubby industrial cutter with a pistol grip and a short, flat teal blade of plasma at the nozzle. Scorch marks on the housing.

asteroid_chunk.brief: Lumpy asteroid rock to throw. Accent: copper.
asteroid_chunk.description: A fist-sized lump of grey-brown space rock with a few hard facets and pocks, small enough to throw. One shape, heavy black shadow underneath.

stun_baton.brief: Baton with two prongs and a zap between them. Accent: mustard.
stun_baton.description: Upright, prongs at the top: a rubber-gripped baton with two bent metal prongs and a flat mustard zig-zag spark between them.

mining_pick.brief: Asteroid mining pick with a crystal tip. Accent: copper.
mining_pick.description: The pick head runs along the top two cells, the handle drops down the left cell; the empty corner stays free. Meteor-iron head with a teal crystal tip and a small thruster on its back, taped grip, tether clip.

fang_dagger.brief: Dagger with a large animal fang as the blade. Accent: bone.
fang_dagger.description: A single curved bone-white fang lashed to a short wrapped hilt with cord. The fang is most of the shape.

flare_gun.brief: Wide-barrelled flare pistol. Accent: rust red.
flare_gun.description: A short, wide-mouthed pistol with a fat barrel and a hinge in the middle, a rust-red cartridge rim visible at the back. Scuffed rust-red paint gone dull.

boomerang_blade.brief: Curved boomerang with sharp edges. Accent: copper.
boomerang_blade.description: A flat, bent blade in a wide V across both cells, both outer edges ground sharp, a wrapped grip in the bend. Worn copper inlay along the inner edge.

plasma_sword.brief: Long sword with a flat plasma blade. Accent: rust red.
plasma_sword.description: Upright through the tall box: a short chunky hilt at the bottom with a crossguard of vent fins, above it a long flat blade of rust-red plasma with hard straight edges and a black core line.

harpoon_launcher.brief: Harpoon gun with a barbed tip and rope. Accent: copper.
harpoon_launcher.description: Lying along the long box: a shoulder launcher with a barbed harpoon head poking out of the front, a coil of rope hanging under the barrel. Dented and riveted.

cryo_sprayer.brief: Spray gun with a frost tank. Accent: deep teal.
cryo_sprayer.description: Lying across the box: a spray gun with a round teal frost tank on top, frost crust on the nozzle and a few flat ice crystals flying out.

ion_blaster.brief: Blaster with ring coils on the barrel. Accent: deep teal.
ion_blaster.description: Upright, muzzle up: a blaster with three ring coils stacked round the barrel and a bulky grip. Deep teal on the coils.

spore_launcher.brief: Tube gun loaded with spore pods. Accent: moss.
spore_launcher.description: Lying across the box: a fat tube gun with a breech cracked open, round mossy spore pods visible inside, one pod sitting at the muzzle.

meteor_hammer.brief: Big hammer with a meteor as its head. Accent: rust red.
meteor_hammer.description: Filling the square box diagonally: a short iron haft with a lumpy meteor fused on as the head, the meteor's underside scorched and cracked in rust red from re-entry. Leather wrap on the grip.

tentacle_whip.brief: Whip made from a tentacle with suckers. Accent: moss.
tentacle_whip.description: Along the long box: a wrapped hilt at one end, from it a long tapering tentacle in loose curves, a row of pale suckers on one side.

shock_gauntlet.brief: Armoured glove with sparks around the knuckles. Accent: mustard.
shock_gauntlet.description: A single armoured glove clenched into a fist, heavy plated knuckles, two or three flat mustard sparks jumping between them.

needle_rifle.brief: Long thin rifle firing needles. Accent: deep teal.
needle_rifle.description: Along the long box: a thin, long-barrelled rifle with a slim stock and a drum of needles under the middle, a few needles flying from the muzzle as straight black strokes.

acid_flask.brief: Glass flask of bubbling acid to throw. Accent: moss.
acid_flask.description: A round-bellied glass flask with a stopper wired on, moss-green acid bubbling inside, one drop eating into the glass rim. Bubbles as simple circles.

ripper_saw.brief: Hand saw with a spinning chain. Accent: rust red.
ripper_saw.description: Lying across the box: a short hand saw with a rust-red chain running around a flat bar, a chunky motor grip at the back, teeth as sharp black triangles.

railgun.brief: Very long gun with two parallel rails. Accent: deep teal.
railgun.description: Along the long box: two straight parallel rails as the barrel, a boxy grip and battery block at the back end, braces between the rails. Teal on the rails.

gamma_lance.brief: Long lance with a radiation trefoil on the tip. Accent: mustard.
gamma_lance.description: Along the long box: a long pole lance, its tip a heavy cone with a radiation trefoil painted in mustard, a cable winding down the shaft to a battery at the butt.

swarm_missiles.brief: Rack of small missiles. Accent: rust red.
swarm_missiles.description: A square rack seen from the front, filled with a grid of small rocket noses, two missing; scorch marks round the empty slots. Rust red on the noses.

antimatter_dagger.brief: Dagger with a black blade outlined in white. Accent: bone.
antimatter_dagger.description: A small dagger whose blade is a flat black void with a crisp bone-white outline, iron hilt below. The blade is the darkest shape in the picture.

photon_bow.brief: Bow with a string of light, arrow nocked. Accent: mustard.
photon_bow.description: Upright through the tall box: a curved bow of dark metal with a straight mustard bowstring drawn as a flat line, one arrow nocked across it.

void_scythe.brief: Scythe with a black blade full of stars. Accent: bone.
void_scythe.description: The curved blade sweeps across the top row, the long shaft runs down the left cells; the right lower cells stay empty. The blade is black and speckled with tiny bone-white stars, the shaft plain iron.

solar_cannon.brief: Large cannon with sun rays around the muzzle. Accent: mustard.
solar_cannon.description: A heavy, squat cannon lying across the box, muzzle to one side. Around the muzzle a fan of bent metal plates like a sun-shaped heat shield; scorched plating on the barrel and two fat cables running back into a boxy breech. Mustard only on the plates of the fan.

graviton_maul.brief: Huge maul with orbit rings around its head. Accent: deep teal.
graviton_maul.description: The heavy head fills the upper four cells, the haft drops down the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. Around the round head two thin teal orbit rings tilt at an angle; small debris pieces hang in the rings.

ram_plate.brief: Dented hull plate with a riveted ram spike, scavenged from a wreck. Accent: deep teal.
ram_plate.description: Lying across the box: a dented hull plate with a short riveted ram spike in the middle, a faint teal ring of force around the spike.

drone_bay.brief: Open scrap hatch with three tiny welded drones peeking out. Accent: copper.
drone_bay.description: Lying across the box: an open hatch built from scrap, three tiny welded drones with copper rotors peeking out, one already lifting off.

marrow_treat.brief: Thick cracked bone with marrow, tied with a fur cord. Accent: bone.
marrow_treat.description: A thick cracked bone with soft marrow inside, tied with a fur cord, a few crumbs around it.

trellis.brief: Small lattice of bent lab rods, thin tendrils climbing it. Accent: moss.
trellis.description: A small lattice of bent lab rods stuck in a pot, thin moss-green tendrils climbing up it and reaching sideways.

frost_bell.brief: Small dark bell rimmed with frost, a cold ring hanging below. Accent: deep teal.
frost_bell.description: A small dark iron bell rimmed with frost, a ring of teal cold drawn as ink lines below it.

breach_ram.brief: Short hydraulic ram with a blunt riveted head on a welded arm. Accent: deep teal.
breach_ram.description: Standing upright: a short hydraulic ram on a welded arm, blunt riveted head scuffed bare, teal force lines drawn as ink arcs where its shield field gathers.

siege_ram.brief: Long piston ram with a heavy wedge head and shield plates along its flanks. Accent: deep teal.
siege_ram.description: Lying lengthwise: a long piston ram with a heavy wedge head, salvaged shield plates bolted along both flanks, hoses taped to the piston, teal force lines at the tip.

glutton_toad.brief: Fat grinning toad with three stalk eyes and a cratered belly. Accent: moss.
glutton_toad.description: A fat round moss-green toad sitting upright, wide grin, three eyes on short stalks, crater-like spots on its round belly, cheeks bulging with food, a few crumbs on its chin.

trough_boar.brief: Stocky bristled boar with small tusks, snout deep in a scrap of food. Accent: mustard.
trough_boar.description: Lying across the box: a stocky boar seen from the side, bristled mustard back, small tusks, snout down in a half-eaten root, crumbs flying.

dawn_needle.brief: Thin iron throwing needle with a sun-ray tip and a copper grip. Accent: copper.
dawn_needle.description: Standing upright: a thin dark iron throwing needle, its tip forged as a small mustard sun ray, the grip wound in copper wire with a rust-red band.

zenith_lance.brief: Slim iron lance with a sun disc below its point, a sun ray shooting off the tip. Accent: mustard.
zenith_lance.description: Standing tall: a slim dark iron lance of the order, a small mustard sun disc below a long point, a rust-red band and prayer cords on the shaft, a short sun ray drawn as one flat stroke leaving the tip.

pebble_mites.brief: Three tiny rock-shelled mites crawling over a pebble. Accent: bone.
pebble_mites.description: Three tiny mites with rock-like shells crawling over a single pebble, feelers up.

needle_wasps.brief: One needle wasp with a syringe stinger and solar-sail wings. Accent: mustard.
needle_wasps.description: One single needle wasp in side view: lean striped body, a long hollow stinger like a syringe needle, stiff ribbed wings like small solar sails, a cluster of small eyes.

thorn_hedge.brief: Dense low hedge of thorny branches grown out of a cracked lab planter. Accent: moss.
thorn_hedge.description: Lying across the box: a dense low hedge of thorny branches growing out of a cracked lab planter, black hooked thorns, a torn strip of suit fabric caught in them.

rot_bloom.brief: Wilted dark flower in a specimen jar, thick sap dripping from its petals. Accent: rust red.
rot_bloom.description: Lying across the box: a wilted dark flower slumped out of a cracked specimen jar, drooping petals with no eyes or face, thick rust-red sap dripping from the tips into a small puddle.

dune_ox.brief: Shaggy ox with wide curved horns and sand caked on its coat, head lowered. Accent: mustard.
dune_ox.description: Filling the square box: a big shaggy ox with wide curved horns, head lowered, sand caked on its long coat, a short breath cloud at its nostrils, one front hoof scraping the ground.

tundra_yak.brief: Yak from a frozen night planet, ice-spiked coat, snowshoe hooves. Accent: bone.
tundra_yak.description: Filling the square box: a huge yak from a frozen night planet. Its shaggy coat is stiff with blue ice spikes, its hooves are wide and flat like snowshoes for walking on frozen methane seas, and big pale eyes for the long darkness. Short heavy horns, a dented copper bell on a rope.
